full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. 1945, July 9
Pastor's Residence Church of St. Michael Los Angeles, California July 9th 1945
V. Rev. Fr. Marion, O.F.M. Cap. St. Bonaventure's Detroit, Michigan
Rev. Dear Father Guardian:
God bless you and all the Brethren.
Thanks be to His merciful providence for all His blessed designs. Whether to my discredit or other- wise, I am still here in this remarkable part of country. Instead of a day as I figured on, its more coming a week since I arrived in Los Angels. - A name well befitting such a gentle wonder-land.
Last Saturday, after Fr. Stephen (O.F.M. Cap) wired to you, he informed us that the very best he could do - in regard to transportation - was to get "reservations for next Thursday (12t) instead of yesterday (9th) for Seattle, so that I may use my "pass" to St. Paul. To get on the train as I pro- posed, without reservation, he stressed would be foolhardiness. So here I am still - hoping to make the best of missing the privileges of the Chapter.
With one or two exceptions, I have met all my nephews and nieces and their children. A few of them seem "straying the way of worldlings," but thank God that seems rather exceptional - here and in San Francisco, in Portland and in Seattle. After all, however, it is not going to be my pres- ence that will work anything worthwhile. Rather it will be someone's prayers.
